items.title: What HD Holders Got Paid While The Stock Fell Behind
items.summary: Home Depot sent its owners a torrent of cash, yet the stock trailed the market. Here is the accounting of what that trade-off actually bought, and what it means now.

items.title: The Market Is Paying You To Own MELI. Why?
items.summary: The market is offering a Latin American e-commerce giant at a steep cash discount, but the price tag comes with a serious question about the cost of growth.

items.title: CRM Stock Passed Our Value-Trap Test. Now What?
items.summary: After a steep fall from its highs, Salesforce looks cheap next to the market, forcing investors to decide if the software giant is a bargain or a broken business.

items.title: AT&T Barely Moves With The Market It Belongs To
items.summary: Five years of data say the stock has largely gone its own way, and what that is worth to a portfolio has nothing to do with the past week.

items.title: JNJ Keeps Climbing. Should You Climb On?
items.summary: This healthcare giant is on a serious run, but with the stock trading at a peak, investors must decide if the powerful business engine has more fuel or if the price has already burned it all.

items.title: The Wreckage And The Cash Register At ADBE
items.summary: The market has punished this software giant’s stock as if its business model were cracking, yet its financial engine continues to run with remarkable efficiency.

items.title: $49 Billion In Payouts, A Lagging Stock: The PFE Trade-Off
items.summary: Pfizer sent shareholders a fortune in cash, yet the stock fell far behind the market, forcing a hard question about what all that money truly bought.

items.title: Here's exactly why small-cap stocks are outperforming the S&P 500
items.summary: The Russell 2000 (^RUT) has been outperforming the S&P 500 (^GSPC) this year as investors rotate into small-cap stocks. Janus Henderson Investors Small Cap Growth Portfolio Manager Jonathan Coleman joins Brooke DiPalma on Market Catalysts o explain what’s fueling the small-cap rally and why the group could have more room to run.
